title: Customer conference and 2025 range launch
author: Marketing
excerpt: The annual distributor conference launched the 2025 aluminium door and shutter ranges and set out the distribution plan for the year.
body: The annual conference for distributors, dealers and partners launched the 2025 aluminium door and roller shutter ranges.
What is new in the ranges is mostly in the hardware and the control side rather than the sections: the ranges carry over the profile work and add to what sits behind it.
The board also set out the year’s distribution plan — growth through the existing dealer network rather than around it, and closer work with the partners already carrying the range.
